evidence.target: installed rc.2 SubagentRuntime.startContinuable authority versus M8 spawn success wording

evidence.target: M8 raw opaque child-id API versus existing M5 checkpoint ownership
evidence.note: M8 says rlm_spawn returns an opaque child Session id and M5 never serializes child ids. The contract must freeze a non-snapshottable Session-local capability or an equally explicit prevention/clearing rule before implementation, so restored Python cannot retain an id or authority.
